intro: Bad Daddy's Burger Bar is a casual 'better burger' chain concentrated in the Southeast and Colorado, built around chef-driven signature burgers, a big build-your-own program, hand-spun shakes and a from-scratch bar menu. Beyond burgers it does chicken sandwiches, salmon, salads and loaded starters like truffle fries and fried mozzarella. Below is the full Bad Daddy's Burger Bar menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Bad Daddy's, the Classic Smashburger is about $8.45, most signature burgers run $11 to $15, and the loaded Bad Ass Burger is $17.95. A build-your-own burger is $12.75, chicken sandwiches are about $11 to $13, and hand-spun shakes are $6.45 to $8. Starters like truffle fries ($10.95) and fried pickles ($8.95) round out the bar menu.
hot_deal: Bad Daddy's value: the Classic Smashburger ($8.45) and BD's All American ($9.75) are the cheapest way into the burgers, and a build-your-own ($12.75) lets you control the spend. Hand-cut fries, tots or chips are only $3.50 as a side. The loyalty program and app drop occasional deals. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a burger at Bad Daddy's?
faqs.a: The Classic Smashburger is about $8.45 and BD's All American $9.75. Most signature burgers run $11 to $15, and the loaded Bad Ass Burger tops out at $17.95. A build-your-own burger is $12.75. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: Does Bad Daddy's have a build-your-own burger?
faqs.a: Yes. The create-your-own program lets you choose your patty (beef, smash, chicken, black bean), cheese and toppings for about $12.75. There are also create-your-own smash burgers, sandwiches and salads.

faqs.q: What is Bad Daddy's known for?
faqs.a: Bad Daddy's Burger Bar is known for chef-driven signature burgers, a big build-your-own program, hand-spun shakes (including spiked versions for adults), and a from-scratch bar menu with truffle fries and loaded deviled eggs.

Bad Daddy's publishes nutrition information in its restaurants and online, but item calories are not reproduced here and are left blank rather than guessed. Build-your-own burgers vary a lot with the patty, cheese and toppings you pick.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Bad Daddy's?
faqs.a: Favorites include the Smash-N-Stack, the loaded Bad Ass Burger, the create-your-own burger, the hand-cut truffle fries, and the hand-spun shakes.
